decisive_items: bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses
sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells
intermittent fevers, episodic night sweats, decreased appetite
response.rationale: Retroperitoneal and adrenal masses with B symptoms and atypical mononuclear infiltrate strongly favor lymphoma; pyomyositis is contradicted by antibiotic failure and biopsy findings, while sarcoidosis lacks granulomas and typical imaging pattern.

rejected.why: Antibiotic failure and atypical cells on biopsy argue against infection; myositis/edema are nonspecific.
No granulomas described; systemic symptoms and atypical infiltrate are more consistent with lymphoma.
